title: 第1867章 矿母灵脉第1866章 繁衍壮大
slug: 培养神兽很难我有十只
content_zh:
星舟上的人很是震惊，在看到青火凤凰虚影的时候还以为看到了真正的凤凰神兽。
难道楚少野不仅有纯血龙兽还有纯血凤凰？
真是令人艳羡。
不过现在星域中的众人就算再羡慕，也不敢对纯血龙兽和青火凤凰有什么想法，毕竟楚少野如今的实力太强，让人只有望尘莫及的份儿，不敢生出别的心思。
三眼青凤这次突破的很快，等青火凤凰虚影消散，它回到楚少野身边飞了一圈才落地。
虽然这段时间它被小狐狸调教的很惨，但这些罪没有白受，如今它是岁星境了。
楚少野拍了拍它的翅膀，将它收回了灵府中，一同收回的还有其他灵宠。
许久没有回紫衡星了，现在可以和灵宠们一同回去了。
虽然现在三眼青凤的实力还是没有追上小狐狸它们，但也不急于一时，拔苗助长反而不利，三眼青凤现在刚突破到岁星境，境界还需要稳固。
——
回到紫衡星上，楚少野把星尘蚁后召唤出来给慕蔷薇看了看。
慕蔷薇先前只听说过星尘蚁后，这还是第一次见，普通的星尘蚁黑漆漆的，长的也有些狰狞，没想到星尘蚁后还挺好看。
她摸着星尘蚁后白玉似的身体对楚少野到：“你这只星尘蚁后似乎和寻常的有些不同。”
她之前是没有见过星尘蚁后，但也了解一二，星尘蚁后应该只有额头上有金色的王印才对，可楚少野这只却浑身上下都有淡金色的纹路。
楚少野道：“大概是因为还是王卵的时候就跟我契约了的缘故，受神力滋养所以才会有些不同。”
刚诞生还是卵的时候就受神力滋养的灵宠，估计就星尘蚁后一个。
慕蔷薇道：“你这只星尘蚁后一看就资质不凡，相信很快就能突破到九阶。
虽然星尘蚁后本就有九阶潜力，只要按部就班修炼就能成为九阶星兽，但也是有天赋资质差距的，楚少野这只星尘蚁后绝对是佼佼者。
楚少野摸了摸星尘蚁后光滑的脑袋，他也希望如此，只是星尘蚁后刚诞生不久，他总有种不太真实的感觉，尤其是在看到由星尘蚁后繁衍出来的星尘蚁群时。
其他灵宠大都有幼崽阶段，星尘蚁后难道不还是个孩子吗？

紫衡星如今已经建设的差不多，除了主星外，星群中的其他星球也已经走上正轨。
虽然是紫衡少主，但楚少野回来后也没有什么事做，在新紫衡星上逛了逛。
紫衡星上的人是都知道他们有位厉害的少主，如今已经是星域中的第一人，但知道楚少野长相的人并不多，走在街上不怕被人认出来。
原来的紫衡星是相当适合人族和星兽栖息的宜居星球，星球以星兽资源为主，搬家后只有主星和附近的几颗小型星球是资源星，资源还不算多，星兽资源更少。
如今到这里来自然不能再靠星兽生存，好在楚少野在几颗合适的荒星上埋了矿母，慕蔷薇也有几颗存货，都拿了出来。
content_en:
The people on the star boat were shocked. When they saw the phantom of the green fire phoenix, they thought they were seeing the real phoenix beast.
Could it be that Chu Shaoye not only has a pure-blood dragon beast but also a pure-blood phoenix?
It's so enviable.
However, no matter how envious everyone in the Star Territory is now, they don't dare to have any thoughts about the pure-blood dragon beast and the green fire phoenix. After all, Chu Shaoye's current strength is too strong, which is beyond the reach of others and they dare not have other thoughts.
The three-eyed green phoenix broke through very quickly this time. When the shadow of the green fire phoenix dissipated, it returned to Chu Shaoye and flew around before landing.
Although it was trained miserably by the little fox during this period, these crimes were not in vain, and now it is in the Suixing realm.
Chu Shaoye patted its wings and took it back to the spirit mansion, along with other spiritual pets.
I haven’t returned to Ziheng Star for a long time, and now I can go back with my spiritual pets.
Although the strength of the three-eyed green phoenix has not yet caught up with the little foxes, they are not in a hurry. It would be detrimental to them to encourage others. The three-eyed green phoenix has just broken through to the Suixing realm, and its realm still needs to be stable.
——
Back on Ziheng Star, Chu Shaoye summoned the Stardust Ant Queen and showed it to Mu Qiangwei.
Mu Qiangwei had only heard of the Stardust Ant Queen before, and this was the first time she saw it. Ordinary Stardust Ants were dark and ferocious in appearance, but she didn't expect the Stardust Ant Queen to be quite pretty.
She touched the white jade-like body of the Stardust Ant Queen and said to Chu Shaoye: "Your Stardust Ant Queen seems a little different from the ordinary ones."
She had never seen the Stardust Ant Queen before, but she knew something about it. The Stardust Ant Queen should only have a golden king's seal on her forehead, but Chu Shaoye's one had light golden lines all over its body.
Chu Shaoye said: "It's probably because you made a contract with me when you were still a king egg, and was nourished by divine power, so it's a little different."
The Stardust Ant Queen is probably the only spiritual pet that was nourished by divine power when it was just born as an egg.
Mu Qiangwei said: "You, the Stardust Ant Queen, have extraordinary qualifications at first glance, I believe you will be able to break through to the ninth level soon.
Although the Stardust Ant Queen has ninth-level potential and can become a ninth-level star beast as long as she practices step by step, there is also a gap in talent and qualifications. Chu Shaoye, the Stardust Ant Queen, is definitely the best.
Chu Shaoye touched the smooth head of the Stardust Ant Queen. He also hoped so, but he always had an unreal feeling when the Stardust Ant Queen was just born, especially when he saw the Stardust Ant colony that was reproduced by the Stardust Ant Queen.
Most other spiritual pets have a cub stage, isn't Queen Stardust Ant still a child?
The construction of Ziheng Star is almost complete now. In addition to the main star, other planets in the star cluster are also on the right track.
Although he was the young master of Ziheng, Chu Shaoye had nothing to do after he came back and just walked around the new Ziheng planet.
Everyone on Ziheng Star knows that they have a powerful young master, who is now the number one person in the Star Territory, but not many people know what Chu Shaoye looks like, and they are not afraid of being recognized when walking on the street.
The original Ziheng Star was a livable planet suitable for humans and star beasts to live in. The planet was dominated by star beast resources. After the move, only the main star and a few nearby small planets were resource stars. There were not many resources, and the star beast resources were even less.
Naturally, we can no longer rely on star beasts to survive here. Fortunately, Chu Shaoye buried the ore mother on a few suitable wild stars, and Mu Qiangwei also took out a few stockpiles.
